pages.text: In this ritual a $(#ad03fc)Phantom$() is spawned using the life energy of a $(#ad03fc)Flying Passive Mob$() and immediately possessed by the summoned $(#ad03fc)Foliot$(). The $(#ad03fc)Possessed Phantom$() will always drop at least one $(item)Phantom Membrane$() when killed. Using this ritual is easy to trap $()
the phantom and you can has comfy sleep.$(br)
